headline: Patna Police bust international cyber fraud network, arrest four
summary: Patna Police busted a cyber fraud network operating from the Musallahpur area and arrested four people accused of targeting customers in India and abroad — allegedly using malware, APKs and internet-based calling to pose as tech support and demand money for fake computer repairs. Around Rs 3.5 lakh in linked bank accounts has been frozen.

headline: Over 35 Munger Engineering College students fall ill; food poisoning suspected
summary: Panic at Munger Engineering College hostel after more than three dozen students — and some staff — fell ill with vomiting, diarrhoea, fever and weakness. They were treated at Sadar Hospital and most were discharged. Vishwakarma Puja prasad served on campus is suspected, but the exact cause is unconfirmed and an enquiry has been ordered.

headline: BPSC, Daroga aspirants march in Patna over alleged paper leaks; clash with police
summary: Thousands of government job aspirants marched from Gandhi Maidan toward the CM's residence demanding cancellation and re-examination of the 70th BPSC exam and Daroga (sub-inspector) recruitment over alleged irregularities. Protesters pushed against police barricades at JP Golambar and Dak Bangla Chauraha; police resorted to lathi-charge.

headline: IMD warns of heavy rain, storms across Bihar including Patna
summary: The IMD has warned of heavy rainfall accompanied by storms and lightning across many Bihar districts including Patna, as a depression over the Bay of Bengal moves in. After a largely dry September 21, rain is expected to pick up again from around September 23.

headline: Patna Civil Court evacuated after email bomb threat; nothing found
summary: Patna Civil Court received a bomb threat by email, prompting evacuation of the premises and searches by police, bomb disposal and dog squads. No suspicious object was found. It is the latest in a recurring series of hoax email threats to the court.

headline: Sonu Sood speaks on Bihar floods in Patna, calls for permanent solution
summary: Actor Sonu Sood, speaking to ANI in Patna, expressed concern over the severe flooding affecting Bihar and said a permanent solution is needed for flood-hit regions.

headline: Bihar UGMAC 2026 Round 2 rank cards released; choice locking open
summary: The Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board released the UGMAC 2026 Round 2 rank cards for MBBS, BDS, BVSc and BFSc counselling. Choice filling and locking continue, with provisional seat allotment scheduled for September 25.

headline: Patna airport steps up bird-strike prevention drive
summary: Authorities announced fresh measures to reduce bird-strike risk at Patna's Jayprakash Narayan International Airport — curbs on garbage heaps, meat and fish shops and laser lights within about 10 km of the airport. The move follows recent bird-related flight disruptions, including an IndiGo diversion to Varanasi.

headline: Liquor smuggling via Ganga river route busted near Patna
summary: Police busted a liquor smuggling operation that was allegedly using the Ganga river as a waterway to ferry alcohol from Uttar Pradesh into prohibition-state Bihar, according to a News18 Bihar/Jharkhand report. Single source — treat with caution.

headline: Minor student alleges sexual assault in Patna's Shastrinagar; FIR filed
summary: A minor college student alleged she was sexually assaulted by a young man she knew in the Shastrinagar area. Police registered an FIR, conducted a medical examination, and are tracing the accused using a mobile number. The allegation is under investigation. Single source — treat with caution.

headline: Minor girl allegedly pushed from moving Patna-Ara train; stable
summary: A minor girl was allegedly pushed from a moving Patna-Ara passenger train near Phulwari Sharif station. She was taken to hospital and reported stable. Railway police are investigating; the exact circumstances remain unclear according to police. Single source — treat with caution.

headline: Bihar Education Department assistant branch officer suspended in Patna
summary: An Assistant Branch Officer (Sahayak Prashakha Padadhikari) of Bihar's Education Department was suspended in Patna, reportedly following a News18 Bihar/Jharkhand report. Single source — treat with caution.

headline: 'The Vvaan' film team meets Bihar CM; Chhath traditions praised
summary: The team of the folklore-fantasy film 'The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest' (starring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia) met Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary in Patna after observing Chhath Puja. The CM appreciated the film for bringing Bihar's traditions to mainstream Hindi cinema. Single source — treat with caution.

headline: Rail mega block Sep 21–Oct 4 to hit Bihar train services
summary: Railways will take a mega block for track-doubling work affecting train operations in Bihar from September 21 to October 4, according to a News18 Bihar/Jharkhand report. Passengers should check schedules. Single source — treat with caution.
